categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Does not touch files under src/index/ or alter index data, interfaces, or internal synchronization logic.
categories.rationale: While the issue involves BIP 157 block filter availability, the changes are entirely localized to P2P message handling in net_processing rather than index code.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies message processing in src/net_processing.cpp to park racing compact filter requests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a network interoperability bug where BIP 157 light clients disconnect or ban Bitcoin Core nodes after requesting filters for newly announced blocks. Under BIP 157, clients interpret non-response for an advertised block as protocol misbehavior, which is a significant recurring issue for light client ecosystems.
